title: Cosmic Arch of Eternity
description: A surreal visionary scene featuring a massive stone archway and the Colosseum at sunset, with a glowing blue cosmic portal floating above. Four ethereal women with dark skin and elaborate hairstyles emerge from colorful nebulae in the sky, while a large crowd of people watches a procession of figures and horses moving toward the arch.
prompt: Surreal visionary painting showing a monumental stone arch and the Roman Colosseum at sunset with a bright sun on the horizon. Above the arch floats a glowing blue geometric cosmic portal surrounded by swirling colorful nebulae and stars. Four majestic African women with elaborate updos emerge from the clouds in the upper corners. A massive crowd of people fills the foreground while a procession of riders and figures moves through the arch. Shooting stars and dramatic sky with vibrant cosmic colors.
